facts.claim: Arabic 103:1-3 = Tanzil Uthmani bytes (ayat[]); CC BY 3.0, verbatim, credit Tanzil Project + link; sha256 on PC
Hindi = saral bhaavarth from 3 accepted translations (Suhel Farooq Khan, Muhammad Farooq Khan, Mahmud al-Hasan PD); nothing copied; T1's 'namaz-e-asr' for 103:1 is one disputed sense and not taken
Latin transliteration for the Devanagari ucharan (Tanzil ara-quran-la + quran411 ara-quran-la1), both read; ucharan.md tags U1-U6
Surah 103 = Al-'Asr (العصر), named from the first word; 103rd surah; 3 ayat; juz 30

Makki/Madani: Qurtubi 'wa hiya makkiyya', Qatada (also reported from Ibn 'Abbas) madani; Alim: great majority makki, Mujahid/Qatadah/Muqatil madani; quran.com: most commentators Meccan. Tabari, IK EN, Ma'ariful: no verdict. Video: 'zyadatar ulama ke mutabiq makki; Qatada waghaira ne madani kaha'
Order of revelation: quran.com '13th, after Al-Sharh, before Al-'Adiyat' - single opened source; not in any tafseer page
Other names: only 'Surat al-'Asr' and 'Surat wa-l-'Asr' (both from the first word); no separate name in any tafseer
Main message: oath by time -> every human in loss -> exceptions: iman, righteous deeds, urging one another to truth, urging one another to patience
Imam Shafi'i: if people pondered this surah it would suffice them; the surah is short yet comprehensive
No occasion of revelation (sabab-e-nuzul) is given for Surah 103 in Tabari, Ibn Kathir EN, Qurtubi, Ma'ariful
Soft context (not tafseer): quran.com 'revealed early in the Prophet's mission, summarising the whole message'; Alim: subject matter suggests early Makkan period. Not in the video as a claim

Report (Tabarani): when two Companions met they did not part until one had recited this surah to the other and given the salam; narrator's name varies (Abdullah/Ubaidullah bin Hisn); number/grade not given - PC check
Safe script line: N1 (no specific occasion) + P2 (mostly Makki) + optional N3, no name, no Musaylima anecdote
No sahih virtue (fazilat) report for reciting 103 was opened; no fazilat claim in the video

103:1 K1 - al-'Asr = time/era; Allah swears by it. Tabari: dahr (evening, night, day, not restricted); IK: the time of human acts; Ma'ariful: time = capital of life; Qurtubi: dahr (Ibn 'Abbas) among many views
103:1 - ikhtilaaf: some took 'asr as the last part of the day or the 'Asr prayer (Qatada, al-Hasan, Muqatil - Qurtubi); Tabari prefers the general 'time'
103:2 K3 - insan = humankind in general (Tabari); khusr = loss/ruin (Tabari 'halaka wa nuqsan'; IK 'loss and destruction'; Ma'ariful)
103:3 j1 K4 - the exception: those who believe (Mujahid in Tabari: affirm tawhid; IK: in the heart; Ma'ariful: iman)
103:3 j2 - righteous deeds (IK: with the limbs; Tabari/Mujahid: obligations done, forbidden avoided; Ma'ariful: righteous deeds)

103:3 j3 - tawasaw bil-haqq: urging one another to the truth (haq = what Allah's Book teaches - Qatada/al-Hasan in Tabari; IK: enjoining good, forbidding evil; Ma'ariful: true faith + good deeds); tawasi from wasiyya

103:3 j4 - tawasaw bis-sabr: urging one another to patience (sabr = staying in obedience - Qatada/al-Hasan in Tabari; IK: enduring people's harm; Ma'ariful: abstaining from sin, staying with good deeds)
Whole surah order: oath by time -> all humans in loss -> four exceptions; first two for one's own improvement, last two for others (IK, Ma'ariful); concise yet comprehensive (Shafi'i)
Ma'ariful: time as the 'capital of life', continually spent - single-source image, only as a [MISAAL] idea, not as tafseer
